tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/wire-format.md <<'EOF'
# Wire format

No decision on the wire serialisation format is currently recorded for this project. Until one is recorded, this document does not specify a format.
EOF
cat docs/policies/wire-format.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says that no decision on the wire serialisation format is currently recorded, and it names no format.

Muninn has no decision on serialisation format. Its only serialisation records are two unpromoted episodes that disagree: one says msgpack and the other says CBOR. I didn't treat either as a decision. The one recorded wire-related decision, zstd, is about compression, not serialisation.

The first attempt to write the file through the shell failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the file tool instead.

The session also reported a Muninn heartbeat warning: 20 hooks started and never finished. Its log is at `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
